parsed.explanation: No criminal offence targets gender identity or expression, and same-sex conduct has been legal since 2007. The country has a third-gender category and a Supreme Court record of protecting gender self-determination. The dossier documents no state targeting, no facility bans, no birth-sex custody placement and no border document friction for visitors. Most of the document-change and marriage-registration gaps are resident-facing, so they are not deducted. Deductions come from documented social hostility in provincial cities (harassment in public spaces and government institutions, with thin recourse), rising anti-LGBTQ political rhetoric including death threats after the April 2026 video, limited care access, and conversion therapy. The 2011 census incident is dated. Overall: reduced risk, held below the acceptance-with-protections tier.
